```sql
/* Рассчитываем excellence rate = numge1500 / numtsttakr, берём топ-3 уникальные школы и выводим их телефоны */
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."sname",
        s."numge1500",
        s."numtsttakr",
        s."numge1500"::numeric / NULLIF(s."numtsttakr", 0) AS excellence_rate
    FROM "satscores" s

      AND s."numtsttakr" > 0

)

    ON sc."school" = r."sname"
WHERE r."sname" IN (
    SELECT r2."sname"
    FROM ranked r2
    GROUP BY r2."sname"
    ORDER BY MAX(r2.excellence_rate) DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
GROUP BY sc."phone", r."sname"
ORDER BY MAX(r.excellence_rate) DESC;
```

```sql
GROUP BY nc."first_name", an."district"
ORDER BY nc."first_name", an."district";
```

```sql
/* Находим округ с наибольшим числом закрытых школ */
WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT cc."county"
    FROM county_counts cc
    ORDER BY cc.closed_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
/* Выводим название каждой школы и дату закрытия для этого округа */
SELECT
    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON cs."county" = tc."county"
ORDER BY cs."school";
```

```sql
    "city",
    COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM k8_schools
GROUP BY "city"
ORDER BY school_count DESC;
```

WITH female_clients AS (

           c."birth_date",

oldest AS (

    FROM female_clients
)

SELECT a."account_id",
       (ls."max_salary" - ls."min_salary") AS salary_gap
FROM female_clients fc
JOIN oldest o ON fc."birth_date" = o."min_birth"
JOIN lowest_salary ls ON fc."avg_salary" = ls."min_salary"
JOIN "disp" dp ON dp."client_id" = fc."client_id"
JOIN "account" a ON a."account_id" = dp."account_id"
ORDER BY a."account_id";

```sql
JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = om."uuid"
WHERE LOWER(l."status") = 'legal'
ORDER BY l."format";
```

```sql
    (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN cnt END), 0)::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0) * 100)
    AS percentage_difference
FROM yearly
CROSS JOIN total t
GROUP BY t.total_cnt;
```

```sql
FROM post_stats;
```

```sql
WHERE cb.consumption_2012 IS NOT NULL
  AND cb.consumption_2013 IS NOT NULL
  AND cb.consumption_2012 <> 0;
```
